scientific_integrity: Exact proof by line incidence, finite-étale scissors identities, and Frobenius orbit analysis; direct finite-field enumeration corroborates restricted cases. No assertion of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: For q>=5 and Sziklai-optimal degree-\(q-1\) smooth plane curves only; the theorem is for the reduced maximal-flex tangent-line union. The geometric Fermat arrangement and generic arrangement-zeta techniques are already known; exact arithmetic-priority uncertainty remains.
title: The finite-étale class and zeta function of maximal-flex tangent lines on Sziklai-optimal curves
